כֹל צְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם is rule 29's fronting case: the rectum is rendered anarthrously as 'heaven', so its present article takes the phrase's single 'the' and the construct צְבָא takes nothing. פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה is the arthrous case, with two written 'the's split between the supplied one on the construct and the article's own.
The three לְ of the sun/moon/host series are read by rule 22: the first takes the single written 'before' and the second and third are unrepresented.

Resultative לְ takes 'for' under rule 49 while the copula stays on the present הָיָה, and the waw plus לֹא fuses as 'nor' under rule 35. Partition and heads verified across 49 source and 61 target ids.
